text: 你守夜期间，诺曼安静得像个小木偶。最后你叫醒西尔维娅，自己去睡觉。黎明前，一声尖叫惊醒了你。你睡眼惺忪地抬头，望向营地另一边。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 236
text: Through your watch, Norman lies quiet as a mannikin. You finally wake Sylvia and turn in. Sometime before dawn, a cry breaks your sleep. You raise your bleary head and peer across the campsite.
